rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for removing your own clothes.

example.english: I undress and take a shower as soon as I get home.
example.traditional: 我一返到屋企就除衫沖涼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 ceoi4 saam1 cung1 loeng4

rows.note: Use this casual alternative when emphasizing stripping off a garment.

example.english: After playing football, I immediately undress because I’m covered in sweat.
example.traditional: 踢完波我即刻剝衫，成身都係汗。
example.jyutping: tek3 jyun4 bo1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 mok1 saam1 sing4 san1 dou1 hai6 hon6

rows.note: Use this construction when helping or causing another person, especially a child, to take off their clothes.

example.english: I’ll undress my son first; he’s all sweaty.
example.traditional: 我幫個仔除衫先，佢成身汗喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 go3 zai2 ceoi4 saam1 sin1 keoi5 sing4 san1 hon6 laa3
